sourceFindings.assignment: User-directed replacement of unavailable Browser review with source-only critique of the first 30 technology detail routes and template.
methodology: Read DESIGN.md, technology skill and authoritative schema/dimension definitions; user source-only constraint overrides the skill's research workflow.
Read all 30 complete MDX source profiles, shared detail template, icon resolver, Academy recipe, content matching and newsletter/SEO state contracts.

Parsed existing frontmatter with installed gray-matter in read-only Node commands; counted assets, body words and matching content. Did not invoke Astro, Bun tests, cuenv, builds or dependency installation.
Matched technology references as strings or object IDs, normalizing /index suffix; excluded draft articles. Counts describe source eligibility, not a generated or rendered page.
Stored hashes of 41 source files to bound evidence. No current external facts, prices, link availability, SVG appearance or delivered emails were researched.
Browser attempts ceased at user direction; zero new Browser calls, screenshots, page navigation, submissions, authentication changes or implementation edits.

priorityDefinitions.blocking: Confirmed source defect prevents truthful or accessible sign-off for the affected state; implementation owner must resolve before claiming complete acceptance.
priorityDefinitions.nonblocking: Composition improvement, mitigation, conditional risk or unverified state which does not establish a current broken page.
priorityDefinitions.infrastructure: Original AUDIT-B001 remains an evidence blocker. This source report does not convert any rendered status to passed.

findings.title: Software entity asserts Academy authorship and a free offer for every project

evidence.note: Default siteName is Rawkode Academy; SoftwareApplication creator and publisher use that name; operatingSystem Any and USD 0 offer are unconditional.
AWS Lambda is explicitly Commercial and its body describes paid per-millisecond execution.
Every profile emits this shared software entity.

findings.impact: Machine-readable claims contradict the authoritative profile and misattribute third-party software, including AWS Lambda, to the editorial publisher. A zero-price software offer is not established by an open-source license either.
findings.recommendation: Keep Academy as the article publisher; omit unsupported software creator/publisher, operating-system and pricing fields unless backed by explicit authoritative metadata. Do not invent vendor facts to fill fields.
findings.proofBoundary: Direct source/data contradiction, not a rendered SEO inspection or external product fact-check.

findings.title: Anonymous successful subscription removes its own success announcement

evidence.note: Anonymous cookie flag forces shouldHide=true independently of isSuccess.
Successful action sets isSuccess and hasCookieSubscription together; outer v-if excludes the entire widget including role=status.
Headline/subtitle live outside the widget and remain while the successful anonymous control subtree disappears.

findings.impact: A confirmed action removes the focused form/control and the intended polite success message, leaving promotional copy without confirmation. No explicit focus destination is provided.
findings.recommendation: Keep the current successful interaction and its confirmation visible/announced; suppress only already-subscribed subsequent visits. Define focus handling when replacing controls.
findings.proofBoundary: Vue branch analysis only. No subscription, DOM interaction, assistive-technology run or live submit performed.

findings.title: Topic signup promises differ between visible and assistive copy; abandoned Acorn needs explicit editorial framing

evidence.note: Every lifecycle receives [technology] updates / Stay Updated on [technology]; subtitle specifies new Academy tutorials, courses and videos.
Email help promises weekly cloud-native updates for every audience.
Acorn is abandoned; body explicitly says repository unmaintained and no security updates planned.

findings.impact: Assistive copy promises a weekly/general newsletter where visible copy offers topic-specific publication notifications. Acorn headline can be read as project updates despite its lifecycle. The visible subtitle mitigates that reading; abandoned does not itself prohibit future Academy coverage.
findings.recommendation: Use one audience-specific promise without unsupported cadence. For Acorn, explicitly describe historical coverage/migration-related Academy publications, or use a neutral Academy signup. Preserve the abandoned metadata.
findings.proofBoundary: Copy contract reviewed; delivery cadence/pipeline and live preference service not verified.

findings.title: Related technologies match subcategory alone and discard lifecycle context

evidence.note: Fallback matches subcategory without parent category, sorts nothing explicitly, limits six, and only passes name/logo/subcategory to cards.
Serverless / Tools.
App Definition and Development / Tools therefore also matches Lambda.
Abandoned Acorn remains eligible for all Application Definition & Image Build peers.

findings.impact: AWS Lambda can recommend Xdebug due to the generic word Tools across different categories. Historical projects can appear as unqualified alternatives. None of these 30 profiles supplies explicit relatedTechnologies.
findings.recommendation: Make fallback respect the hierarchical category, expose lifecycle for archived alternatives, and distinguish taxonomy siblings from curated alternatives. Preserve useful historical routes; do not silently delete them.
findings.proofBoundary: Source-derived eligibility, not observed rendered rail order. Actual Astro collection ordering was not executed.

findings.title: Rawkode’s take becomes an unexplained status-only section on all 29 rated profiles

evidence.note: Four identity facts precede the article; matrix adds a full heading with conditional explanation.
Stable lifecycle and graveyard personal matrix state coexist without a matrix why/confidence/date.
Matrix is an adoption/opinion journey, distinct from project lifecycle.

findings.impact: All 29 matrix entries in this batch lack why, spicyTake, confidence and usage dates; 27 contain only the rendered matrix status, and two add trajectory. Sixteen say Skip. This consumes section hierarchy and may make personal preference read as objective project health, especially Cadence stable/graveyard.
findings.recommendation: Keep the opinion, but use a compact clearly personal rating unless explanatory content exists; explain the distinction from lifecycle. Keep metadata in semantic dl and do not manufacture rationale.
findings.proofBoundary: Source density assessment; spacing, fold position and visual hierarchy not measured.

findings.title: Raw CNCF useCase text is promoted directly to the hero

evidence.note: useCase is preferred to editorial SEO description and inserted as escaped plain text.
Literal cert-manager\_is and a long multi-sentence paragraph.
Cluster Multi-Tenancy,Policy-based tenancy is a tag-like comma string, not a concise explanation.

findings.impact: cert-manager’s escape remains a literal backslash/underscore rather than Markdown formatting; its hero duplicates much of the opening definition. Capsule gets imported taxonomy text instead of its clearer opening prose.
findings.recommendation: Use a presentation-safe concise description only when available; avoid raw imported fields as authored prose. Do not rewrite technology facts in this task.
findings.proofBoundary: String/source insertion confirmed; no screenshot or line-height claim.

findings.title: Multiple project actions point to identical destinations

evidence.note: Only falsy filtering; no URL deduplication.
Official website and source share the runtime repository; documentation is its readme fragment.
Website and source both point at moby/buildkit.
Website and Documentation are both carvel.dev.

findings.impact: Two labels promise distinct choices for one destination, adding focus stops and hero density without added utility.
findings.recommendation: Deduplicate exact URLs with an honest combined label; preserve distinct fragments and real documentation destinations. New-window links should communicate that behavior.
findings.proofBoundary: URL equality only; destinations were not fetched.

findings.title: Usable non-icon project artwork is ignored

evidence.note: Icon resolver returns undefined without logos.icon, while a separate horizontal resolver exists.
Profile uses icon resolver only.
Horizontal logo declared and local horizontal.svg exists.
Horizontal/stacked assets declared and present; no icon.

findings.impact: Identity is still honestly represented by full title, but two profiles omit available genuine artwork. Four other no-icon profiles have no local logo assets at all and should not receive invented artwork.
findings.recommendation: Optionally support aspect-ratio-preserving horizontal artwork; retain text-only fallback where no real asset exists.
findings.proofBoundary: Filesystem availability only. No SVG rendering, loading or light/dark contrast check.

findings.title: Latest videos omit publication dates and subject relevance/context

evidence.note: Video links display thumbnail and title only.
publishedAt and duration are available but not used in the profile.
Carvel linked recording is dated 2020.
Acorn tutorial predates the abandonment statement.

findings.impact: Historical tutorials lack age context, particularly sensitive beside abandoned Acorn. Argo has eight tagged videos, with top titles covering other tools/platform topics; matching a technology tag does not establish that every clip is a dedicated tutorial. Argo and BuildKit split 8/6 videos into 4 aside plus 4/2 below.
findings.recommendation: Preserve every useful recording and destination; show date and distinguish tagged/related recordings from dedicated tutorials. Do not infer live-now from stored type=live. Evaluate the long sidebar only when Browser is available.
findings.proofBoundary: Content dates/title/tag association inspected, not playback or visual density. Distinct Docker Build Cloud assets were checked and are not incorrectly flagged as duplicates.

findings.title: Technology video selector has no publication-time boundary

evidence.note: Matches technology references and sorts newest first, with no publishedAt check.
Watch related selection does enforce publishedAt <= now.
Article/news/path matching similarly does not check future dates.

findings.impact: Future non-live content could lead the Latest videos rail without an upcoming state. Current first-30 matched content contains no future dates at the supplied 17:28 checkpoint, so this is a latent template issue, not a demonstrated current leak.
findings.recommendation: Reuse the established published-video policy, or explicitly represent scheduled live sessions. Keep hasTopicContent and TopicHub predicates aligned if editorial publication policy changes.
findings.proofBoundary: Source collection scan cutoff 2026-09-20T16:28:00Z; no build or getCollection runtime executed.

findings.title: Expanded newsletter has no visible label and incomplete pending-state semantics

evidence.note: Expand button has no expanded/controls relationship; email label is sr-only; submit accessible name stays Submit email subscription during pending while title/spinner change.
Expansion does focus the input and errors use role=alert.
Focus styles exist; submit is 36px within a larger input, not a missing-style assertion.

findings.impact: Placeholder substitutes for the design-required visible field label. Loading feedback differs between signed-in text button and anonymous icon button. Keyboard state transitions require explicit verification.
findings.recommendation: Keep native form/input, persistent visible label and unique IDs; expose expansion/pending state and preserve confirmation focus. Do not introduce a modal/focus trap for this inline form.
findings.proofBoundary: Markup/recipe review only; no keyboard, screen-reader or target-size measurement.

findings.title: Preference lookup failure and deferred/hydration failure lack an honest unavailable state

evidence.note: Preference error leaves isSubscribed=false; controls use client:visible.
Deferred server island has no explicit fallback slot.
Anonymous initial action is JS-only expansion; no native fallback form is present.

findings.impact: A preference outage presents the normal Subscribe state even when subscription is unknown. With unavailable island/hydration, the user has no explicit retry/unavailable explanation. A pre-existing anonymous cookie can hide the island while its outer labelled section remains.
findings.recommendation: Represent unknown/error separately from unsubscribed; define meaningful deferred/no-JS or hydration-failure behavior. Suppress the complete section when intentionally hidden rather than leave a named empty landmark.
findings.proofBoundary: Failure branches are source-derived; no outage or no-JS browser state exercised. Normal preference length check is valid because unsubscribe deletes its row.

sectionDispositions.rationale: Page wrapper delegates header/footer and supplies focusable main with skip link. Shared shell internals were not re-audited; no rendered/footer coverage claimed.
Native breadcrumb nav/ordered list, current-page text and full h1. Optional real logo has empty alt beside title and hides on error; no invented identity.

Keep semantic dl and explicit authored status/license. Most profiles need no duplicate lead when body opens with a definition; raw imported useCase needs cleanup. No missing/defaulted statuses in this batch.
Real descriptive anchor destinations with noopener/noreferrer, no '#' placeholder controls. Remove exact duplicate choices and disclose new-window behavior.

All 30 have 168–315 whitespace-counted words across three paragraphs; no body headings/embedded media. Plain SSR article avoids complete-guide claims. Honest overview fallback exists but no concrete batch route exercises it.

15 profiles have 35 video appearances; first four plus remainder preserves all. Titles remain linked if thumbnail fails. No image-error replacement for video thumbnails is provided; runtime failure appearance pending.
29 personal ratings, zero authored explanation/confidence/usage dates. Avoid full opinion section for a one-word rating; retain the rating itself.

22 CNCF panels and 17 community sets are grounded in metadata; conditional dates/links prevent empty sections. External destinations are not verified live. No need to expose every imported tag/persona/release-cadence field.

Matching article for apko, news for Backstage/cert-manager; none of the 30 match learning paths. Shared string/object-reference normalization and showVideos=false avoid contradictory empty hubs and duplicate video rails.
Keep genuine links/identity, but fix cross-category generic-subcategory matching and make historical lifecycle visible rather than imply curated current alternatives.
The audience-specific action is real preference storage, not a decorative button. Confirmation is source-broken for anonymous success; wording/labels/loading/unavailable branches need attention.
Keep canonical breadcrumb/RSS discovery and article metadata. Remove unsupported software creator/publisher, offer and platform claims; no need to discard useful SEO structure.

stateReview.result: Source retains all 30 MDX bodies, semantic heading and ordinary links; actual compiled HTML not inspected.
Six no-icon profiles omit img; four have no local artwork, two have horizontal/stacked assets. No fake Academy/initial-tile identity.
Inline onerror sets hidden; recipe explicitly hides img[hidden]. JS-disabled image failure and emitted CSP behavior not exercised.
Honest Overview fallback defined; none of first 30 exercises it.
Conditionally omit video/CNCF/community/hub blocks. All 30 have article prose; no generic empty-content message needed. TopicHub reference guard matches source object/string shapes.
Deferred widget starts with JS-driven Subscribe, expands and focuses labelled email input. Label is visually hidden; no fallback without island/hydration.
TECH-SB02 confirmed by state predicates: cookie flag hides success subtree.
Server/client suppression exists. Outer technology updates section is unconditional and may remain empty.
Preference row yields Subscribed; service deletes rows on unsubscribe, so prefs.length>0 is not falsely classified as a status-filter bug.
Success waits for action success, error uses alert, button disables during pending. Replacing focused control lacks explicit focus handling; runtime announcements unverified.
Lookup error logs and leaves false rather than unknown. No unavailable state.
Native anchors/forms, breadcrumb/current-page, focus recipes and shell skip target exist. No modal controls here. Actual tab order/focus visibility/AT behavior not exercised.
Recipes contain responsive semantic-token branches; neither mode rendered. No viewport/theme verified or changed.
